notes: Display names, short names, URL slugs and category words for ICAO Doc 8643 type designators. Names are curated public type designations; they are not database values.

Coverage: the 200 designators with the most aircraft-days in this collection's daily table (2026-06-01 to 2026-10-05), every rules.WATCH_TYPES code, every designator behind a curated notable variant, and the designators of aircraft whose database year is 1951 or earlier.
Codes that share a slug name one type (for example E75L and E75S, both the Embraer 175). Group designators name categories, never types, and get no type page.
short_slug drops the manufacturer and is used only to keep long story slugs within 80 characters.

same_as is the English Wikipedia article for the type, for designators in published stories and in rules.WATCH_TYPES. Each title was resolved through the MediaWiki API with redirects followed, checked to be a plain article (not a redirect or disambiguation page) with a Wikidata item, and fetched with HTTP 200. Where Wikipedia redirects a variant name to its family article (Boeing 757-200, C-5M Super Galaxy, Citation CJ4), same_as names that family article. The field is absent when no article clearly matched.

2026-10-24: 246 designators seen in this collection since 2026-06-01 were added, with names checked against ICAO Doc 8643 and the Mictronics aircraft descriptions. Categories added: fighter, turboprop trainer, gyroplane.
